+216 24220813 | skan.nasri@gmail.com https://github.com/skaandernasri
https://www.linkedin.com/in/skander-nasri https://skaandernasri.github.io/skandernasri.github.io/
Full-Stack & DevOps Engineer experienced in designing, developing, and deploying scalable applications. Skilled in modern web technologies, CI/CD automation, and cloud-native environments.
Background in Business Intelligence and strong interest in Artificial Intelligence and data-driven systems, with a focus on building intelligent and efficient solutions.
Frameworks & Libraries: Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Angular, SvelteKit, Laravel, Symfony, React, NextJs
Testing & QA: JUnit, Mockito, Spring Test, REST Assured, SonarQube
DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Docker Compose, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Ansible, Nexus, GHCR, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure, AWS
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
API & Tools: Swagger / OpenAPI, Git, GitHub, Power BI
Tempo-Rise - Full-Stack & DevOps Engineer
Architected and delivered a production-ready e-commerce platform using Spring Boot and Angular, serving live traffic with zero critical downtime post-launch.
Designed and automated CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and GitHub Actions, reducing deployment time by ~70% compared to manual processes.
Containerized the full stack (app, DB, monitoring) using Docker and Docker Compose, ensuring environment parity across dev and production.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and deployment via Ansible, eliminating ~80% of repetitive manual server configuration tasks.
Implemented real-time monitoring and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana, enabling proactive incident detection.
Integrated an MLOps pipeline for automated LightFM model training and evaluation powering the product recommendation system.
Developed and integrated the customer-facing storefront using Shopify, unifying frontend, backend, and database into one cohesive production system
Personal Project - DevOps Pipeline Project
Built a complete CI/CD pipeline from scratch triggered by Git webhooks, covering build, test, quality gate, artifact publishing, and deployment stages.
Integrated JUnit & Mockito for automated testing and SonarQube for code quality analysis, maintaining a quality gate pass rate above 90%.
Centralized artifact management with Nexus and enabled real-time monitoring with Prometheus & Grafana.
ETAP - Tunisian Petroleum Activities Company - DevOps / System Automation Intern
Automated ERP-Active Directory synchronization using PowerShell, reducing user provisioning time by approximately 65%
Developed auditing scripts and Power BI dashboards that gave management real-time visibility into system health and user activity.
Confledis (France) - Software & DevOps Intern
Contributed to Docker-based development environments and CI workflows within a collaborative, Git-driven team; gained exposure to professional DevOps standards in a French software company.
CNAM - National Health and Social Insurance Fund (Tunisia) - PFE - Open-Source Document Management Platform 2021 - 2022
Designed and developed an open-source web platform using Spring Boot and Angular, enabling CNAM administrators to publish and manage official documents for clients nationwide.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) distinguishing admin and client permissions, ensuring secure and structured document access.
MLOps Specialization - Coursera
English: B2 | French: B2
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals - Microsoft
